measurement: P phase spans use one host's monotonic clock. D/client timings use their local clock. Paired deltas are B minus A. Predecessor deltas require equal stable batch rows. First worker is the earliest of the four ranks, last host forward is the latest. First-batch GET spans include gaps between recorded native calls. The pending batch count excludes the future just popped for the result wait. ADD queue attribution requires overlap with the matched prior worker wait and dequeue after the scheduler finishes its result update.
